touches.text: Machine: tools plus the glue that holds them together. Has an owner. Anything that calls another component, uses other tools, or owns state it must gate is a machine. Lives inside its device (cairn/devices/<device>/machines/<machine>/), or in cairn/machines/ when several devices hold one (16).
TOOLS: base, chain, bus_client; db client; machine openai_wire: speaks OpenAI's wire format to the inference proxy, in the shim, per 5.8.3.8.
WHY: the base-most things (the six truths, logging, diagnostics, the core patterns) must be the same everywhere, so they are written once and inherited.
The base classes all inherit from base, and so bring its logging, diagnostics and core patterns with them:
